approaches.title: Top-down recursive dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Uses recursive search from each string index with memoization to cache failed positions. Revision 2 simplifies control flow while preserving the same strategy.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implements recursive word-break search with memoization of failed indices.
Simplifies the recursive loop by returning immediately when a valid continuation is found.

approaches.title: Bottom-up dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Builds a boolean DP table from the empty prefix through the full string. Each position records whether it can be reached by appending a dictionary word.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces recursive memoization with iterative bottom-up DP over string prefixes.
